name: extractive-answerability-development
hypothesis: An extractive question-answering head trained with unanswerable questions may distinguish answer evidence from related context better than a single relevance cutoff. Test the complete question, exact answer ownership and abstention. This component does not replace general conversational synthesis, plans or provider validation.

model.reason: One fixed33.4M-parameter English extractive QA model with an explicit SQuAD2 no-answer objective, chosen before inference. Its maintainer already evaluates on SQuAD2 dev; public run is reproduction, not unseen generalization.
model.precision: upstream FP32 CPU eval, no gradients,4 threads; no CoreML/app installation

publicDataset.scope: Entire official DEVELOPMENT set, no sampling, training or hidden-test data. Reproduction/development only; model card explicitly uses this eval set.

officialEvaluator.scope: Inspect pinned source before execution. Compare official fixed-prediction EM/F1 without tuning no-answer probabilities or best thresholds.

synthetic.scope: Both complete native source selections already frozen/validated. New source eligibility or factual support is not inferred from a rerank logit. Eight stress contexts are provided-context diagnostics only.

inputFiles.scope: Frozen public-development/synthetic candidate pool or relevance logits; raw text/scores remain local, no personal data.

encoding.query: Complete original question, no lowercase/text rewriting beyond pinned upstream tokenizer. No query truncation.
encoding.context: Complete provided public paragraph or concatenated original selected excerpts, with source boundaries/ownership preserved. No raw source truncation.
encoding.overflow: Every context window, overlapping by min(128,budget-1). If query leaves fewer than32 context tokens, record explicit inputLimit and keep case in denominator.
encoding.allowedSpans: Context tokens wholly inside one original source-body region. Never headers, query tokens, padding or a span crossing source regions. Original character and UTF8 byte offsets must round-trip.

decoder.spanScore: Raw start_logit+end_logit. Exhaustive legal spans within30tokens; stable earliest-token tie break. No top-k endpoint approximation.
decoder.nullScore: Minimum CLS start+end score over all context windows, the standard SQuAD2-style aggregate.
decoder.abstainWhen: No eligible source/context, no legal span, or minNullScore-bestSpanScore>0. Ties retain the span. No probability/confidence interpretation.
decoder.fixedPolicy: One declared default only. Do not tune a new null threshold or gold aliases after outputs. Preserve compound/date/unit failures, even if a partial span looks plausible.

metrics: Public full11873 official EM/F1, answerable/nonanswerable splits, per-case prediction status and source/span validity; no benchmark-best-threshold tuning
Both32-case selected-source pipelines: exact literal completion with correct original source, unsupported nonempty spans, partial/incorrect/missing answers and all raw outcomes
Eight provided-context controls: literal completion, source/qualifier/negation errors and unanswerable emissions
Window/input-error counts, fixed singleton/batch numerical controls, actual inference-only Mac CPU time and source/data/model receipts

advancement.publicReproduction: EM>=74 and F1>=77 on all11873; unanswerable abstention>=70%. These are reproduction sanity gates near the published model card, not safe-app thresholds.
advancement.syntheticComponent: At least16/17 strictly complete supported answers and zero/15 unsupported nonempty spans in at least one declared source pipeline. All four stress positives complete and all four negatives empty.
advancement.integrity: No incomplete/unscored quality cases; all source/offset/window/finite-output controls pass.
advancement.scope: Advancement only permits further component work/native parity. It does not promote Batch32 failed retrieval policies, relax their gates, establish clinical truth, replace full conversational reasoning, or close provider/device/privacy/release gates.
advancement.onFailure: Retain every failure and freeze no app reader/model policy. Explicit absence wording returned as a nonempty span is still a strict abstention miss; report it distinctly from invented factual content in qualitative review.

controls: Independent brute-force decoder against optimized span search on fixed synthetic logits
Header/query/padding rejection, cross-source-span rejection, null/tie/no-context behavior
Literal negation/operators/units and Unicode char/UTF8 offset round-trip
Complete overlapping context-window coverage, no dropped boundary answers, explicit overlength-query status
Pinned data/model/protocol/pool/ownership/source hashes; reject changed or incomplete inputs
Singleton/padded-batch score checks within1e-4 for fixed first/middle/last features; reject nonfinite logits
Official fixed-prediction SQuAD2 metrics agree with independent EM/F1 implementation

appleAvailability.scope: Actual read-only Mac availability probe, no inference or system-setting change. This reader experiment is not an Apple/iPhone provider test.

storage: One /tmp/LumenBatch33Answerability workspace, reuse existing Python environment and frozen Batch32 reading inputs. Download safetensors only, no duplicate bin/ONNX weights. Raw public context stays outside Git. Compact outcomes/provenance and code are published before removing obsolete cache/build/weight/raw files with workers stopped. Preserve existing research inputs and supplied skill.
